record.body:
## Evidence

R8 specifies effort only. The design invariant asks for the phase ref when a phase exists. init creates placeholder phases, not a chosen phase.

## Consequence

Ideas promoted through init carry an effort and no phase ref until a later phase is chosen.

## Follow-up

User decides: keep R8 as written, or have init set the first placeholder phase.

payload.basis: R8 says effort; the design invariant says the phase ref is set when a phase exists; init creates placeholder phases
payload.claim: judgment on promote-writers: init promotes with effort only, leaving the idea phase ref empty
payload.invalidated_when: the user accepts effort-only promotion on the init path or changes R8

record.subject: review-promote-writers-init-phase-ref
